note: Approximate price levels, rounded. central = average kr/kvm for bostadsrätter in the central parts of each city (Svensk Mäklarstatistik-based reporting, early 2026). dearestStreet = the city's most expensive street, kr/kvm, sales apr 2025–mar 2026 (Fastighetsbyrån / Svensk Mäklarstatistik; streets with <5 sales excluded). riket = whole-country average for bostadsrätter, approximate.
